scope: Read-only codebase analysis; no code or data migration performed
finding: Health declarations currently have two independent persistence and display paths.

alertsBehavior.impact: A declaration saved only through the legacy route can exist in the database while remaining invisible to DriverHub document expiry alerts.

recommendation.title: Hide the legacy /health-declaration path
rationale: DriverHub document_versions is already the alert-aware canonical path.
Keeping both entry points visible creates a silent split-brain state that users cannot reliably diagnose.
Hiding the legacy route is lower risk than an immediate merge because it avoids schema mapping, historical deduplication, expiry backfill, and attachment migration decisions.
Option ג (merge) should be a later, separately approved migration with reconciliation rules, rollback, and historical-data validation.
notPerformed: No Production or Hostinger system was accessed
